title: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi: define an abuse report method (mimid's Room/reportAbuse and the converting party's Message/reportAbuse)
description: mimid now has two INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC methods for protocol-07 §5.9 reportAbuse (decisions mimid-1wgh.57, mimid-1wgh.58): Room/reportAbuse on the provider (client-assembled AbuseReport relayed to the room's hub) and Message/reportAbuse on a converting party's plaintext endpoint (JMAP Message ids mapped to the kept franks). draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 has neither. Writes to ~/PROJECT/jmap-chat-spec need Mark's OK. Questions for the text: the response codes (accepted, notAllowed, unverifiedMessage, refused), whether an anonymous report (empty reportingUser) is allowed, and whether the converting party must keep each received frank (protocol-07 §5.4.1.3 says the receiver needs to store it).
